name: FormToSS Contact Form 7 to Google Sheets with no code!
author: 【公式】FormToSS-フォムトス-

sections.description:
FormToSS is a WordPress add-on plugin that allows you to automatically output Contact Form 7 form data to Google Sheets.

When data is sent via a Contact Form 7 form on your website, that data is also sent to Google Sheets upon form submission.

  • No complicated settings are required, and integration can be achieved without any coding.
  • The number of forms that can be linked is unlimited.

Website | User Guide | Support

PRO Features
FormToSS has a paid plan with more features.

  • Unlimited linked sites (domains) and number of forms.
  • Freely configurable output destination sheet and start cell.
  • Supports customization of Google Sheets, such as “adding columns” and “adding rows”.
  • Multiple forms can be linked to a single Google Sheet.

For details about the features of the ForoToSS paid plan, please refer to the feature comparison page.
Price List

How to Use This Plugin
Step:1 – Google Sheets
→ Log in to your Google Account and access Google Sheets.
→ Create a new sheet and name it.
*This step is not necessary if you are using an existing sheet.

Step:2 – WordPress Admin Panel
→ From the WP admin panel, click “Plugins” -> “Add New”.
→ Enter “FormToSS” in the search input field and click “Install”.

Step:3 – FormToSS
→ Access FormToSS and log in with your Google account.
→ From the “Link Sheet” button, select the Google Sheets and tab to link. With the PRO features, you can configure the details of the linkage from the “Settings” button in the form list.
→ Copy the two items, “FormToSS Authentication Key” and “Link ID” for each form, to the clipboard.
*FormToSS Authentication Key: Click the copy icon in the left sidebar menu of the admin panel.
*Link ID: Click the copy in the form list.

Step:4 – WordPress Admin Panel
→ Access the Contact Form 7 dashboard, select the form to output to Google Sheets, and click “Edit”.
→ Select the “Form ID” tab, paste the copied “FormToSS Authentication Key” and “Link ID”, and click “Save”.
→ Test form submission and verify that the data is displayed in Google Sheet.

External services

This plugin connects with the FormToSS API (https://formtoss.com/mypage) to send form input data to a Google Spreadsheet.

The following data will be transmitted:
● FormToSS Authentication Key: A unique key issued to you by FormToSS.
● FormToSS Integration ID: A dedicated integration ID issued to you by FormToSS.
● Form Input Data: Information entered by users into a contact form that is integrated with FormToSS.

This data will be sent at the following times:
● When this plugin is installed on WordPress and user authentication with FormToSS is completed
　→ FormToSS Authentication Key

● When a contact form (CF7) configured in WordPress is integrated with FormToSS
　→ FormToSS Authentication Key, FormToSS Integration ID

● When data is submitted through the contact form (CF7) on WordPress
　→ FormToSS Authentication Key, FormToSS Integration ID, Form Input Data

This service is provided by FormToSS.

Arbitrary section 1

*CF7 operating environment version: 5.9.8
sections.installation:
1. From the WP admin panel, click “Plugins” -> “Add New”.
  2. Enter “FormToSS” in the search input field.
  3. Select the “FormToSS” plugin and click “Install”.
  4. Activate the plugin.

OR…

  1. Download the plugin from this page or from the official website.
  2. Save the .zip file to your desired location on your computer.
  3. Open the WordPress admin panel and click “Plugins” -> “Add New”.
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”, then browse to the .zip file you downloaded.
  5. Click “Install Now”, and then “Activate Plugin”.
sections.faq:
CF7 form data is not output to the spreadsheet.
If the form response data is not output to the spreadsheet, there may be several causes.

→ Please check that the FormToSS authentication key and linkage ID are entered correctly.
→ Please check the linkable domains. The free plan allows you to link forms on one site (domain).
To link forms on multiple sites, please consider the [PRO] plan.

*If the problem persists, please check the FormToSS website or the user guide.

Website | User Guide |
